invariants.description: h matches the exact voltage-clamp solution h(t) = h_inf(Vm) + (h_init - h_inf) exp(-t/tau_h(Vm)), with h_inf and tau_h transcribed from the Paci 2013 CellML (not from this module)

bc_sweep.rationale: Vm spans the physiological range of a cardiomyocyte action potential/clamp protocol (-100 to +50 mV); the initial gate value spans its whole range [0, 1].

baseline.reason: candidate: the steady-state/time-constant curves of the h gate in Paci et al. 2013 (fitted to hiPSC-CM voltage-clamp data, Ma et al. 2011) could be digitised and compared with the clamp steady state; not set up (figure digitisation needs owner approval).

calibrate.note: not_applicable: gate kinetics have no free parameters in this module (all constants are hard-coded in the CellML), so there is nothing to identify.
